_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N335263 (2023-10-04, train split; picked: no dev China-held ruling; train China-held): CBP held China. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. Target Hong Kong; plant capabilities for Hong Kong are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: LED grow lights
product.description: LED grow lights designed for high-intensity indoor horticulture and high-efficiency greenhouse applications. Each unit consists of an LED module (PCBA with LEDs), a power supply, lens, heatsink, light box covers, and hardware including screws, cable, connector, and wires.

components.name: LED module (Printed Circuit Board Assembly with LEDs and electronic components)

operations.name: Incorporate numerous electronic components and populate LEDs onto the Printed Circuit Board (PCB) using Surface Mount Technology (SMT) to produce the PCBA
Conduct testing and inspections in each step during the manufacturing of the PCBAs
Assemble the finished PCBAs (with LEDs attached) with the power supply, lens, heatsink, light box covers, connector, and hardware to produce the LED grow lights
